top_signals.title: UAE’s Boom Faces a Wartime Test
top_signals.summary: The UAE’s post-pandemic boom is being tested by a war showing few signs of resolution, as disruption in the Strait of Hormuz drives up import costs and fuel prices. Yet the economy is showing signs of resilience. Bloomberg’s Zainab Fattah reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
